diet.text: Rodents, lizards, frogs, birds and snakes

overview.text: Lichtenstein's Green Racer is a mildly venomous, bright green snake of South America.

identification.text: Green above and yellowish below with smooth scales.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: Much of South America: Brazil, Peru, Bolivia, Paraguay, Uruguay, northern Argentina, Colombia, Venezuela and the Guianas.

habitat.text: Cerrado, Caatinga, forest and restinga, from sea level to 1,700 m.

behaviour.text: Active by day, often climbing but also hunting on the ground.

diet.text: Small rodents, lizards, amphibians and birds (especially nestlings), and other snakes almost as big as itself.

reproduction.text: Lays 4 to 11 eggs, each about 5 cm long.
